concerns: If README.md is missing the implementer must stop and report, never create a substitute file.
If the diff touches any file other than README.md the review rejects and it is corrected; no silent fallback.

commands: legion gh -- pr view <n> --json files --jq '.files[].path'  (must list exactly README.md)
legion gh -- pr diff <n>  (must show one added line, no other file)
acceptanceToSurface.criterion: Acceptance 1: PR changes exactly one file, README.md, adding the single line `Stage 3 smoke proof: workflow verified.`; diff shows only that one added line.
acceptanceToSurface.negativeControl: A diff that touches a second file, or adds more than the one line, must be rejected by review — not silently accepted.
acceptanceToSurface.surface: GitHub pull-request diff (production-like: the real merged-PR diff GitHub renders).

commands: legion gh -- pr diff <n>  (still only README.md, now the extra appended line present)
acceptanceToSurface.criterion: Acceptance 2: if review requests it, one more line appended to the same README.md lands on the same PR.
acceptanceToSurface.negativeControl: Landing the extra line in a new file or a different file must be rejected.
acceptanceToSurface.surface: GitHub pull-request diff on the same PR after the corrective push.

fileLevelWork: README.md: append one line `Stage 3 smoke proof: workflow verified.` after the current final line. No other file is created or edited. No build/test/dependency/config change.
plan.implementEvidence: E2E (implementer): PR diff on GitHub shows exactly README.md +1 line `Stage 3 smoke proof: workflow verified.` at head <sha>; negative control: a staged edit to a second file is rejected/reverted before push. No CI/test suite exists to gate a docs-only change.
plan.integrationEvidence: Merger runs `legion threads resolve`, confirms `jj diff --from <approved-sha> --to <tip-sha> --summary` shows no product change above the approved head, publishes READY. Post-merge the implementer confirms the merged PR diff on production (the merged main README.md carries the one line).
plan.notes: No surface-building prerequisite is needed: the GitHub PR diff already reaches both acceptance criteria; no new rig, sandbox, or tooling is required.
ordering: 1. Implementer appends the single line to README.md; verifies `jj diff` shows exactly one added line in exactly one file (README.md).
2. Implementer sets bookmark legion/S391388879-1, pushes, opens PR with body containing `Dispatch: S391388879-1`.
3. Tester independently re-runs the PR-diff check.
4. Reviewer reviews the PR head diff.
5. If review requests one more appended line (acceptance 2), implementer appends it to the same README.md on the same PR.
plan.reviewEvidence: Reviewer confirms on GitHub the PR diff is the single README.md added line, no other file; runs thermonuclear pair at final head; approves the head carrying no .legion/.
plan.summary: Append exactly one new line reading `Stage 3 smoke proof: workflow verified.` to the end of sjawhar/legion-smoke README.md on the issue smoke branch legion/S391388879-1, open a PR, change nothing else.
plan.targetFile: README.md (confirmed present at workspace root, 11 lines).
plan.testEvidence: E2E (tester): re-run `legion gh -- pr diff <n>` and `pr view --json files`; verdict verified that exactly one file (README.md) changed with the one added line. implementerProof {verdict: verified, how: re-ran the implementer's pr diff command}.

implement: legion-worker: drives the only surface this change is proven on. It governs appending the single line to README.md, setting the legion/S391388879-1 bookmark, pushing, opening the PR with the `Dispatch: S391388879-1` line, and recording the E2E proof that the diff is exactly one added line.
review: legion-worker: governs the one-review-per-round GitHub PR review, individual thread disposition, and approval only of the head whose diff is the single added README.md line.
test: legion-worker: governs verifying the implementer's PR-diff proof and independently driving the same GitHub PR-diff surface to confirm exactly one added line in README.md and that no other file changed.

workflowRecommendation: Trivial one-file change: single implementer, single tester, single reviewer, no build/test/CI wiring. No decomposition or parallelism.
